centre.name: Life Science Addiction Treatment

about_blocks.text: Life Science Addiction Treatment Center is a private, residential facility specializing in treating drug or alcohol addiction in English-speaking adults and elders. The focus of the treatment is not limited to addiction, but also on the assessment, diagnosis, and treatment of additional mental health issues. The program offers short, moderate, or long-term inpatient treatment tailored to meet the unique needs of each patient.

The focus of the treatment is not limited to addiction, but also on the assessment, diagnosis, and treatment of additional mental health issues. The program offers short, moderate, or long-term inpatient treatment tailored to meet the unique needs of each patient.

about_blocks.text: The Life Science Addiction Treatment Center stresses a 12-Step Introduction as one of the specific components of its program. The 12-step facilitation for addiction treatment is directed toward helping individuals become involved in self-help groups such as Alcoholics Anonymous. The center understands the importance of group support in the recovery process and encourages its patients to connect with others who have similar challenges. The program also includes medical and psychiatric assessments, education, life skills training, group and individual therapy, exercise, leisure, and recreational activities.

about_blocks.text: Located on Quebecs’s Rigaud Mountain is the serene and natural surroundings of Life Science Addiction Treatment Center’s Mountainside campus. The center is located within reach of medical and hospital services in both Quebec and Ontario. Its secluded mountain location offers the perfect, uninterrupted backdrop for peaceful and successful addiction recovery. The clients staying at the center can relax in private and cozy quarters situated on a floor of the house. The quarters are equipped with en-suite bathrooms and access to necessary amenities like laundry room and cinema room.

about_blocks.text: The Life Science Addiction Treatment Center’s treatment approach is not just about getting patients off drugs or alcohol. The comprehensive plans prioritize the healing of the whole person- mind, body, and soul. Therefore, the treatment includes medical and psychiatric assessments, education, life skills training, group and individual therapy, and activities such as exercise, leisure, and recreational. Their medical team is available 24/7, and once checked into the program, patients receive immediate care to address addiction-related medical issues.

about_blocks.text: At Life Science Addiction Treatment Center, individuals are welcomed into a supportive and compassionate environment where they can begin their journey towards recovery. The facility’s team of experienced professionals work closely with clients to provide tailored treatment plans that meet their unique needs. Whether short or long-term, the center’s inpatient services are designed to help individuals overcome alcohol and drug addiction in a safe, secure, and comfortable setting.
